# New BOD Handbook: Measurement Technology Theory and Practical Tips


Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) is one of the most important parameters in wastewater analysis. But which measurement method is best suited to which application? How can reliable results be obtained, and which interferences need to be considered?


Our new BOD guide provides in-depth background knowledge on BOD determination and supports you with practical recommendations for everyday laboratory work. From biological fundamentals through sample preparation to the evaluation of measurement results, you receive a comprehensive overview of the key aspects of BOD analysis.


**Contents**


- Fundamentals of Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD)
- Respirometric BOD Measurement and OxiTop® Systems
- Sampling and Sample Preparation
- Handling Interferences and Nitrification
- Evaluation and Quality Assurance of BOD Measurements
- BOD Determination According to ISO and DIN Standard Methods
- Photometric BOD Measurement with Cuvette Tests


[Download the BOD handbook now!](https://www.xylemanalytics.com/en/company/blog/blog/2026/08/bod-handbook-theory-and-practice-tipps-pdf)


Learn how to reliably determine meaningful BOD values and which methods are best suited to your application. After providing your contact details, the guide is available for free download.


*Note: To conserve resources, we provide our technical information exclusively in digital format.*
